title: Sound Comes from Vibrations
summary: Every sound starts with something vibrating: a tabla skin, a veena string, the air in a flute or your vocal cords.
objectives: I can explain that sound is produced by vibrating objects.
I can identify the vibrating part in different sound sources and instruments.
I can describe how the length of a vibrating object affects the pitch.
misconceptions: Sound is made by air only.
Loud sounds come from big objects only.
